event_description: State of emergency for flash flooding that damaged Interstate 15, homes and infrastructure in Clark County and on the Moapa Band of Paiutes Reservation.
State of emergency for a severe weather system with expected flooding in Washoe, Douglas, Lyon and Storey counties, Carson City, the Reno-Sparks Indian Colony and the Pyramid Lake Paiute Tribe.
State of emergency for flooding in Elko County, with the National Guard activated.
Declaration of emergency for the Tamarack wildfire threatening homes in Douglas County.
State of emergency for the Caldor wildfire as it approached the Lake Tahoe basin.
